name: SMS Szent István

sources.title: SMS Szent István — Tegetthoff-class battleship; torpedoed by MAS 15 on 10 June 1918; upside down at 66 m, the bow broken off on hitting the seabed and lying beside the hull; a protected site
Divernet — St Stephen revisited: the inverted wreck at 66 m, the two large propellers and the rudders, the 30 cm guns, a searchlight half buried in the sand
X-Ray Mag — The demise of SMS Szent István

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q642429_sms_szent_istvan.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. Upside down at about 66 m, resting on her deck edge with the upperworks crushed into the bottom; the bow broken off and lying right beside the hull; the two propellers and the twin rudders uppermost; the torpedo holes on the starboard side by the boiler rooms; a searchlight half buried in the sand; plates about. A war grave (89 men). The heading (not published: 0), the angle of the bow and the turrets' state are approximate. model_built.glb: the battleship as she sailed in 1918.
